key_insight: SwarmEvolve accelerates evolutionary program search by letting low-cost AI agents explore and combine ideas in latent space rather than generating textual reasoning.
engineering_relevance: Latent-space collaboration could reduce the time and cost of searching for better algorithms in scientific computing and mathematical discovery.
method: Deploy hundreds of agents per round in swarms exploring different approaches.
Share KV caches and retain distinct ideas using hidden-state distances.
Combine swarm members’ KV caches in a summarizer agent for latent-space crossover.
evidence_signal: Across 21 problems, SwarmEvolve reports the highest average score and median times of 3–8 minutes to match best scores reached by competing frameworks in 60 minutes.
watch_item: KV-cache sharing and hidden-state novelty filtering require internal model access; the abstract does not quantify their memory overhead.
paper_title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization
